quest.lead: Completion status of quests and Junctions. Items whose prerequisites are not complete cannot be ticked (saved on this PC).
quest.placeholder: Filter by name (e.g. Natah / The Second Dream)
quest.note: Click a prerequisite tag to jump to its row. The route lists the incomplete items you need, in order, starting from the earliest prerequisite. MR (Mastery Rank) and other conditions are shown for reference only and are not used for ticking. Rows marked ※ have prerequisites that have not been fully confirmed yet.
quest.col.name: Name
quest.locked.title: Cannot be ticked until its prerequisites are complete
quest.noflow: Prerequisites for this quest are not registered yet
quest.broken: Marked complete, but some prerequisites are incomplete
quest.noexport: Names come from the bundled data. Run "Data Update" to use the official names and to list newly added quests.
